_comment: The rules a university sets, in the one place it can change them.
Everything here is policy: a number a department decided on, not a fact
about software. Editing this file and restarting the service is the whole
procedure - no rebuild, no code change, and the dashboard reads the same
values so the figures it draws are measured against what is actually
What is NOT here, deliberately: which findings reject and which ask for a
correction. That distinction is the argument this service makes - nobody
is refused for something they can fix - and it is not a dial.
Point REVIEW_RULES_PATH at another file to run a different faculty's
rules. A file that cannot be read, or that sets a value outside the
sensible range, stops the service at startup rather than falling back to
the defaults: a coordinator who edits a rule and sees the service come up
would reasonably believe the change took effect.
